\[ \tanh(a + bi) = \frac{\sinh(2a)}{\cosh(2a) + \cos(2b)} + \left( \frac{\sin(2b)}{\cosh(2a) + \cos(2b)} \right)i \]

The issue reported is that when the real part ("a") of the complex number is a "big" number, the method returns NaN (infinity/infinity) instead of the expected result of 1.0.

Given the implementation of the `tanh` method, the problem may occur when the calculations involving `sinh(2a)` and `cosh(2a)` result in infinity due to large values of `a`.
